actions.action: Slide plant out of pot and check rhizomes/roots for rot
If rotten, cut away rotten parts and let dry a day or two
Repot in fresh chunkier mix (universal soil with one-third perlite/pumice/bark)
Check soil is dry several inches down before watering (every 3-5 weeks in winter)
Check and empty standing water in outer pot
Move plant away from window and cold drafts, keep above 15°C
Trim fully yellow stems and leaves at the base
Inspect leaves and stem bases for pests

reason: The answer names overwatering as the main cause and advises checking the roots, repotting in chunkier mix and watering much less often, which matches the fix that worked; nothing in it is harmful.
